steps.text: X — scratch      ↑ + X — scratch upward      ↓ + X in the air — scratch down and bounce

lines: Oh! Oh dear. Good evening.
You've fallen. Everyone falls, down here. That's rather the point of the place.
I'm Tallow. I keep the candles in the Hollows lit. Well. Some of them.
You're looking for someone. You have the look.
A little girl came through in the night. Yellow boots. She was following a moth.
...Not me! A different moth. We don't all know each other.
She went deeper. Everything goes deeper, eventually.
This is the Underneath. It's where lost things go.
It used to be lovely. The Hearthlamp lit all of it, and the light helped us remember who we belonged to.
Then the lamp went out. Now things down here are forgetting. Going hollow.
They'll bite. I'm so sorry about that.

steps.text: If you need to rest, sit by the candles and press UP. I'll keep them burning for you.

lines: The candle likes you. Candles have very good taste.
The girl went east, through the Weeping Tunnels. Mind the thorns. They're not personal.
Is that... a slipper? Oh. Oh, she's so small.
Then she really did go all the way down. Nobody goes all the way down on purpose.
Your shadow looks thicker. Did you borrow one?
It suits you. Shadows are very loyal once they've decided.
You're still here! The wings fit you. My sister would be delighted. And a little jealous.
Up through the Updraft, then down toward the water. I'll keep the candles lit.

steps.title: Mira's Slipper
steps.text: Pink, with a pompom. The mud on it is still wet.

lines: ...lose a ribbon off a tree...
Nightpaw? Is that you?
It's very dark. But there's a moth, and she's showing me the way.
She says I'm going to be a lamp.

steps.text:
Far above, something small and pale is glowing.
It looks a lot like a kitten.
Too high to reach. For now.

lines: The coats sway, though nothing is touching them.
A shadow slips out of an empty sleeve and pools at your feet.
It fits exactly.

steps.title: Shadow Dash
steps.text: It was somebody's shadow once. It seems happy to be yours.
steps.hint: C or Shift — dash. Works on the ground, and once in the air.

steps.text: The thorns are too wide to jump. There might be another way across.

steps.title: The First Life — The Rain Box
lines: A cardboard box by a drain. Rain like pebbles.
You were so small you would have fit inside a shoe.

Then two yellow boots stopped right in front of you,
and a very small girl said: "You're mine now."
And you were.
(The first life doesn't end in dying. It ends when the second one begins.)

steps.title: A Life Remembered
steps.text: One of your lost lives has come home.

steps.title: The Second Life — The Pond in Winter
lines: A leaf skating across the ice, and you right behind it.
The ice sang one long, low note, like a door opening.
Then it was very cold, and very quiet, and very dark.

Mira searched for you until the snow melted.
After that, she always left the back door open. Just in case.

steps.title: A Life Remembered
steps.text: One of your lost lives has come home.

lines: A customer! No. Not a customer. You haven't got pockets.
Nib. Traveling button merchant. Everything I sell is found, not lost. Totally different thing.
You're wondering why I'm standing next to a big pile of rocks.
I'll tell you anyway. My shop is on the other side. Rockfall. Very sudden. Very rude.
When somebody clears it, come and spend those buttons. I'll have hats.
Everybody needs a hat.
Buttons are money down here. Nobody knows who decided. Probably a button.
The Warden's hall is past the coats. He used to catch things when they fell.
Now he just... catches things.
You beat the Warden? With just your claws?
I'm going to have to raise my prices.
NIGHTPAW DONT —

The rest has been scratched out by something with claws.
Much bigger claws than yours.
...FALLING...
SOMETHING... ELSE... FALLING...
MUST... CATCH...
Little one. Did I... catch you?
I used to catch them all. Buttons. Keys. Kittens. Nothing ever broke while I was here.
Then the light went out, and I forgot what my arms were for.
The girl went up the old draught, toward the water. Mothmother's moth was with her.
I'm sorry. Tell her I'm sorry I didn't catch her.
He remembered. At the very end. That's the most any of us can hope for.
You'll need to go up. The draught goes up before it goes down. Everything is backwards here.
Take these. They were my sister's.
She went hollow last winter. She'd want them to be used.

steps.title: Moth Wings
steps.text: Pale wings, dusted with old light.
steps.hint: Press JUMP again in the air to jump a second time.

lines: Jump, and then jump again. Don't look down.
Actually, do look down. That's where we're all going.
I'll keep your candles lit.
Nightpaw! I can hear you!
It's warm here. The moth says I'll be the brightest thing in the whole Underneath.
Is that good? It sounds good.
...Why does everyone look so sad?
